verdict.rationale: Gitea has no built-in natural-language interface, but a probe found an official first-party MCP server (gitea-mcp), which lets an external AI assistant operate Gitea through natural-language requests. The evidence is only a bare probe hit, so the depth and scope of that coverage are unproven. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
